# storagegrid_s3_bucket_policy (Resource)

Manages the S3 bucket policy for a StorageGrid S3 bucket. StorageGrid does not provide a DELETE method for bucket policies, so destroying this resource clears the policy with a PUT request containing a null policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a bucket policy for an existing StorageGrid S3 bucket
resource "storagegrid_s3_bucket_policy" "logs" {
  bucket_name = "logs-bucket"

  policy = jsonencode({
    Id      = "logs-bucket-policy"
    Version = "2015-09-08"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid       = "AllowObjectRead"
        Effect    = "Allow"
        Principal = "*"
        Action    = "s3:GetObject"
        Resource  = "arn:aws:s3:::logs-bucket/*"
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The name of the S3 bucket to configure the policy for.
- `policy` (String) The bucket policy as a JSON string. Provide the policy object itself; the provider wraps it in the StorageGrid API request body.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the bucket policy (same as bucket_name).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by bucket name; the bucket policy must exist.
terraform import storagegrid_s3_bucket_policy.logs logs-bucket
```
